scope: Fixed wording text policy only; no model, browser or medical-semantic validation
checks: Exact unchanged text is safe and explicitly unchanged
Only the eight narrow wording replacements are applied
Dates, quantities, units and repeated numbers stay literal
Same number inventory with changed chronology is rejected
Contradictory negatives and changed scope are rejected
Planned medicine cannot become administered; drugs and doses cannot change
Disease or judgment additions and omissions are rejected
Punctuation, spaces and line structure are not normalized
Chinese and ASCII quotations, templates and book titles remain verbatim
Nested, escaped and unclosed protected spans are preserved
Patient speech rule does not corrupt compound verbs
No broad symptom, severity or nutrition rewrites are allowed
Comparisons use the same whitelist on both sides, without requiring all replacements
Grammar choices are confined to the exact allowed edit spans
Grammar without edits is a single exact literal and tells UI to skip inference
Grammar freezes protected quotations, templates, book titles and line structure
Grammar escapes quotes, slashes, control characters and injection-shaped text as literals
Invalid isolated UTF-16 surrogates fail closed instead of changing text during encoding
